audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows contradicted their own whys and the packet: level 6 was given to Karma while whys[4] says 'level 6 evens out'; first item and 2+ items were given to Illaoi while whys[5] says 'stays even' and whys[6] says 'it's a skill matchup'.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Karma / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Skill / Skill.
audit.corrected: Level 6, first item and 2+ items all set to Skill at 5/10 in both layers as one atomic group. The prose was already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mantra was treated as a fixed window with no number.
audit.why: Mantra is 40s at rank 1, is available from level 1 without a skill point, and Gathering Fire cuts its cooldown every time a damaging ability lands — so poking you actively accelerates it. That is why 'wait for Mantra downtime' needs a number to be usable.
audit.corrected: 40s and the Gathering Fire reduction written into the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Focused Resolve was described as 'her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it', with the line-of-sight half unsupported, and wants.foe[0] credited her empowered Q with a 'slow-root'. Mantra Inner Flame creates a delayed cataclysm; the root belongs to W.
audit.why: Riot's text: the tether roots only if it is NOT broken, and Mantra Q adds a delayed area cataclysm, no root. Attributing a root to the wrong ability makes the player brace against the wrong cast.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, do's and report[5] now state the flat 12s, the 675 range and that walking out of range stops the root; wants.foe[0] corrected to the cataclysm.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds anywhere despite Mantra W healing her.
audit.why: Missing-interactions file flags Focused Resolve as sustain that decides extended trades; Riot's Mantra bonus explicitly heals Karma.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling added to the itemization line and the reason named in report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma is referred to as 'he'/'his' across the trade, wave, feeding and late-game fields.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the fields rewritten here.

notes: Best fact added: Focused Resolve roots only if the tether is NOT broken, and it is a flat 12s at 675 range — so the counterplay is to keep walking out of range, not to wait for a cooldown. The old text hedged this as 'breaks if you LoS / outrange it'; line of sight is not in Riot's description and was dropped rather than asserted. Also corrected wants.foe[0], which gave Mantra Inner Flame a 'slow-root' — Mantra Q is a delayed cataclysm; the root is W. Added anti-heal for the Mantra W self-heal, and fixed the he/his references to Karma.
